findings.summary: Ingress permits public access to TCP port 22.
findings.remediation: Restrict SSH to approved networks or remove SSH ingress.

findings.summary: IAM statement allows wildcard actions on wildcard resources; conditions and external policy controls require human review.
findings.remediation: Scope actions and resources to required workload permissions.
